title: Keyboard controls rebuilt for first-time players
summary: S now brakes and then reverses once stopped, arrows drive like WASD, keyboard tricks are hold J/K (add L) then tap a direction, R resets, and a first-ride controls card (H or the Keys button) shows the live key bindings.
details: Rust keyboard drive adapter (browser_input::BrowserDrive) reuses the touch brake-then-reverse rules per fixed step; host play-test: S slowed 32 ft/s to 6.6 ft/s then reversed, W braked the backward roll then drove forward.
Host play-test trick: holding W, pressing J, then A performed Suicide No Hander; the 150 ms grace stopped held gas forcing an Up trick.
make check passed: Rust workspace tests, clippy, and 144 node tests; new bindings and keyboard-help tests cover migration of saved v1 keyboard profiles.
limitation: Host-only verification at commit a387596; not yet verified on the public build. The opt-in Playwright test tools/test_bindings.mjs was updated but timed out waiting for ?drive=1 simulation startup on the host, so it was not run to completion.
caption: Host build: the keyboard controls card on a player's first keyboard ride at Caribou Peak.
